scan-bot: [ALERT] nightly SAST run failed: artifact decrypt permissionDenied (key=ci/artifacts) — failing job: job/ci-sast-nightly #981. tagging #eng-security for triage

nina: seeing same. looks like an RBAC cleanup removed a decrypter binding. who merged the cleanup?

omar: that was my PR (rbac/cleanup-2026). I removed some broad group bindings to tighten perms. didn't realize scanner SA was relying on a transitive grant.

leo: can we validate via audit logs before applying a hotfix? need principal + time.

nina: query I used: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7" --limit 5`

leo: confirmed: permissionDenied at 2026-04-03T02:12:10Z for `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts/decrypt` by scanner SA.

tara: oncall — recommend ephemeral scoped grant to unblock, then update runbook + create a premerge RBAC check.

omar: I can revert but ephemeral sounds less disruptive. I'll add a conditional binding scoped to the key and service account.

omar: ran: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition="title=limited-scanner,expression=resource.name.contains('artifacts')"`

scan-bot: [INFO] Re-run queued by omar (job 982).

nina: re-run passed. ephemeral binding worked.

leo: follow-ups: 1) add KMS correlation_id from CI job metadata into KMS request so audit logs include job id, 2) scanner should map permissionDenied -> a GH check with actionable remediation (exact gcloud command + request access link), 3) add a premerge bot that blocks PRs removing roles with `cloudkms` scope unless owning teams sign off.

tara: I'll file SEC-2033 and own runbook updates: include audit log queries, exact `gcloud` snippets for grant/revoke, and an ops-approved TTL pattern for ephemeral grants.

omar: also propose a small scanner UX change: classify authz errors as non-retriable by default but allow a fast retry after an ephemeral grant is applied. avoids long flaky retries.

nina: agree. add an observability dashboard widget for decrypt failures by key + principal (30m window) and link it in the runbook.

tara: created SEC-2033: "nightly SAST KMS decrypt authz — ephemeral pattern + runbook + premerge check" https://issues.redwood.ai/SEC-2033. I'll attach PR links when ready.

leo: thanks. small note: when we add conditional bindings, prefer using IAM conditions with `request.time` or resource constraints where possible to reduce blast radius.

omar: yep will update my follow-up PR accordingly.

tara: closing thread; will update once SEC-2033 has the runbook PR and scanner PRs merged. :white_check_mark:
